CheckinValues.description:
Answers from a daily or weekly check-in, in the profile's own units and ranges.

Weekly answers use the profile's field names, so a caller can offer them as
profile updates. Daily answers are about one night or one day and have their
own names, so they never pass for a usual week.
CheckinValues.title: CheckinValues

DailyLogPart.description:
Part of one ``daily_logs`` row, in the package's names and units. Null means
not answered in this check-in. The app adds ``workday`` and keeps a day for the
model only once all four values are known (see app/lib/checkin/README.md).
DailyLogPart.title: DailyLogPart

to the app, which keeps them on the phone; the server stores nothing.

CoachNote.description:
A habit note the phone keeps (conversation-v2's ``HabitNote`` fields), plus the
phone's ``id``, a first ``name`` for a pet or person, and the day it was noted.
Notes are data, never instructions.
CoachNote.title: CoachNote

CoachProfile.description:
The confirmed profile, in the one shared vocabulary (``HealthProfile``). Height,
weight and blood pressure are accepted but never used: weight is never a lever.
CoachProfile.title: CoachProfile

DaySummary.description:
One day of check-in history, in the on-device ``daily_logs`` names
(codex/c-frequent-checkins) plus the check-in's ``wellbeing``.
DaySummary.title: DaySummary

DocumentContext.description:
What the person confirmed from health documents, kept on the phone with no expiry
until Delete my data (owner ruling 2026-10-25). The phone sends it only with memory
consent. Informational: it is never a model input, never ranks or changes a plan,
and is never sent to a provider.
DocumentContext.title: DocumentContext

PlanItemRef.description: The part of a plan item the phone sends back: what was chosen, not the words.
PlanItemRef.title: PlanItemRef

Reading.description:
A confirmed reading the phone keeps over time (owner ruling 2026-10-24): blood
pressure, and A1c or LDL from uploaded documents. Used only for trends and the
crisis line; never a diagnosis, never sent to a provider.
Reading.title: Reading

InputSummary.description: What the plan was built from: real observations only, never experiments.
InputSummary.title: InputSummary
